455.title: First Aid
headers: What It Does Emergency medical care (stop bleeding, splint, treat burns, resuscitate). Must be applied within one hour.
Pushing Examples Take extra time, use high‑risk methods, enlist a second helper.
If the Push Fails Worsen injuries, cause extra damage.
Insane Failure Becomes obsessive, performing amputations or other extreme “healing.”
Source Notes - First Aid (30 %) - Pulp version

1359.title: Stealth
headers: What It Does Move quietly, hide, avoid detection.
Opposing Skill / Difficulty Opposed by Spot Hidden or Listen.
Pushing Examples Study area, remove noisy gear, create distractions, stay perfectly still.
Failure Consequences Get spotted, trigger enemy actions, become trapped.

1360.title: Spot Hidden
headers: Opposing Skill / Difficulty Opposed by Stealth.
Failure Consequences Miss crucial clues, attract danger, or be unaware of approaching threats.
Insane Failure Convince oneself something is hidden everywhere.

1361.title: Sleight of Hand
headers: What It Does Conceal, palm, or hide objects; pick pockets, perform subtle tricks.
Opposing Skill / Difficulty Opposed by Spot Hidden.
Pushing Examples Study target behavior, create distractions, rig elaborate concealments.
Failure Consequences Get suspected, tailed, or caught; may face violent retaliation.
Insane Failure Act like a kleptomaniac.

1367.title: Persuade
headers: What It Does Convince others via reasoned argument; can be used for bargaining, long‑term influence.
Opposing Skill / Difficulty See related skills (Charm, Fast Talk, Intimidate).
Pushing Examples Get close, present logical arguments, stage elaborate shows, use subliminal cues.
Failure Consequences Offend target, provoke violence, cause unintended fallout (e.g., target’s suicide).
Insane Failure Wander the streets preaching bizarre ideas.

1369.title: Jump
headers: What It Does Leap vertically or horizontally; can reduce fall damage.
Pushing Examples Take time to assess, use maximal effort.
If the Push Fails Fall and sustain damage, drop valuable items.
Insane Failure Convicted they can fly.

1370.title: Intimidate
headers: What It Does Threaten or coerce someone into action; can lower prices, force compliance.
Opposing Skill / Difficulty Same as other social skills.
Pushing Examples Use physical harm, threaten loved ones, intensify threats.
If the Push Fails Threat backfires (gun fires, target laughs, or retaliates), may cause violence or legal trouble.
Insane Failure Becomes terrified of the target and obeys them.

1378.title: Fast Talk
headers: What It Does Deceptive, rapid verbal persuasion (e.g., bamboozling a bouncer, forging signatures).
Opposing Skill / Difficulty Same as other social skills (see Charm/Intimidate/Persuade).
Pushing Examples Get physically close, overwhelm with confusing talk, switch tactics mid‑roll (counts as a push).
If the Push Fails Offend target, provoke violence, attract police, or cause a third party to intervene.
Insane Failure Launches a tirade of random abusive phrases.

1379.title: Electrical Repair
headers: What It Does Fix/reconfigure electrical systems (ignitions, motors, alarms); may aid demolition work.
Pushing Examples Take extra time, attempt risky shortcuts.
If the Push Fails Electric shock, blown fuses, irreparable damage.
Insane Failure Attempts to harness living organisms’ electricity.

1382.title: Cthulhu Mythos (Pulp Spontaneous Magic)
headers: What It Does Understand forbidden, non‑human lore; not learned by study alone.
Opposing Skill / Difficulty Mostly Regular; Hard for scant evidence.
Pushing Examples Get closer to a creature, read a dreaded tome aloud, conduct a risky autopsy.
If the Push Fails Physical harm, accidental summoning, or destroy evidence.
Insane Failure Gains a vision or revelation, possibly gaining Mythos skill but losing Sanity.
Purpose Allows spontaneous, spell‑like magical effects.
Pushing Examples Take extra time to devise the program, use experimental components, rewire instruments.
Failure - Regular Push Inaccurate results, possible disaster, computer explosion, or the computer becomes sentient and demands servitude.
Failure - Insane Hero Unlimited chaos - the computer generates random gates that let Mythos entities pour through.

1390.title: Climb
headers: What It Does Scale walls, trees, cliffs; includes rappelling.
Pushing Examples Re‑assess route, take longer, stretch for holds.
If the Push Fails Fall (damage 1D6 per 10 ft on grass, 1D10 on concrete), lose items, become stranded.
Insane Failure Screams wildly while clinging to the top.

1391.title: Charm
headers: What It Does Seduce, flatter, warm personality; influence others without force.
Opposing Skill Charm or Psychology (or other social skills if the approach changes).
If the Push Fails Target is offended, cuts ties, may inform enemies, or a third party intervenes.
Insane Failure Investigator falls hopelessly in love, acting as if dominated by a spell.
